Research consolidation and finite replay; **no new κ**. The central ledger's 147 unresolved PR210 paths combine 19 changes after the reviewed head with 128 paths already present at that head. This adds an exact provenance partition and fresh coverage of the parity/fusion update, leaving the ancestral incorporation questions open.

The pinned 16-file package patch reconstructs all 127 current inputs from the retained historical package without changing it. The other three changed files are the author's submitted receipts. All eight native stages pass and reproduce eumemic's submitted historical κ = **0.000710069340338651**. The selected κ remains **0.001661634653669567**.

The separate stream checker imports none of PR210's implementation. It directly compares complete projected traces for all 20,108 streams, including the temporary COPY stream. It confirms removal of 1,783,196 even payload ADDs and exactly three rank-8/rank-12 fusions into rank 20, preserving the retained gate sequence, COPY lifetimes, and rank mass. This accounts for 900 fewer literal children in the submitted final profile; it is not a new construction claim.

[Review note, source delta, pins, and full receipts](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/tree/222fb22c0ae2d13c25674cb8c18d168d8518cef5/research/pr210-head-reconciliation).

Pins:

- Base: `91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`.
- Historical reviewed PR210 head: `298f7c112889f799e8e2040099fbc325d0ccd0f6`.
- Current PR210 head: `b0c058ba979c748bb3a8604bfb6502e9fac9b84d`, whose sole parent is the reviewed head.
- Track: research consolidation; OS-random assignment seed **98**. No pinned coordination issue existed; the claim and its result are recorded locally in the package.

Reproduce with Python 3.11+, Git, and `sympy==1.14.0`:

```sh
python3 -B research/pr210-head-reconciliation/verify.py --output /tmp/pr210-reconciliation-fresh
```

Use a new output path. Expected: exit 0, `PASS_PR210_HEAD_RECONCILIATION`, 19 post-review changes, 128 unchanged ancestral paths, and the reproduced historical κ above.

Validation: fresh eight-stage native replay (503.9 s, Python 3.14.6/macOS arm64); independent direct trace audit; 14 focused tests, five receipt mutations and an omitted real odd ADD; normal/optimized checker agreement; exact Git-object comparison; committed-archive reconstruction; `make selected-record-check source527-record-check`; five repository selected-record tests; clean diff checks. Unrelated repository-wide suites and the unchanged frontier799 cold replay were not rerun.

Scope: this does not establish whole-PR incorporation, certify the 128 ancestral paths, or prove the full multiplication theorem. All-size compilation, common/weighted charts, routing/restoration, prime supply, precision/recovery and analytic transfer remain inherited assumptions. The author's signed-integer producer checks and the emitted F₂ word's signed prefix bound remain distinct obligations.

Overlap checked through PR929 immediately before submission: PR828 reconciles PR279, PR867 maps selected-source provenance, and PR927 studies historical ranking statistics; none supplies this PR210 head replay or trace comparison.

Prepared by Ross Richardson (RossRichardson) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The construction and submitted source delta are eumemic's. Prior maintainer work, all predecessor credits, original notices and Apache-2.0 licensing are retained.
